title: hiring-sprint-scrapbook-olivia-cho
content:
Purpose: rough personal notebook for the hiring sprint (Nov->Jan cycle). Use for prep before weekly HC syncs, 1:1s with managers, and interview debriefs. Not a finalized plan; lots of TODOs and half-baked thoughts.

Top objectives for this sprint (priority order):
1) Fill 4 IC roles that unblock product Q1 milestones (P0: API infra eng, P0: model-serving SRE, P1: embeddings infra SWE, P1: product reliability SWE).
2) Tighten interview loop and deconflict schedules so candidates get an answer within 7 days of final loop.
3) Reduce time-to-offer for senior IC by 20% via improved scorecards and faster debrief cadence.

High-level constraints:
- Budget: FY26 headcount bucket is largely committed; we have flexibility for 3–5 hires in reserved hiring pot. Need signoff for >5 incremental hires.
- Ramp sensitivity: model-serving SRE must onboard by end of March to hit Q2 SLAs.
- Interviewers: heavy load on infra and applied-ML teams in Dec. Consider rotational interview panels.

Meeting agenda sketch (for weekly HC sync / 30 min):
- 0-5m: Quick wins and blockers (each manager one-liner)
- 5-12m: Candidate pipeline status (by role): #active / #onsite / #offers pending
- 12-22m: Decision items (approvals needed, budget pulls, escalation requests)
- 22-27m: Interview loop health metrics (time-in-stage, pass rates, interviewer coverage)
- 27-30m: Action owner recaps + next steps

Prep checklist for 1:1s with hiring managers (use before sync):
- Bring list of top 3 candidates (cv + short notes) and disposition recommendation.
- Ask managers: must-have vs nice-to-have tradeoffs? Any skill we can deprioritize?
- Hiring manager stretch: Are we open to Level adjustments (e.g., Senior vs Staff)?
- Onboarding support: will buddy/mentor be available in first 2 weeks?

Interview loop proposed changes (quick draft):
- Stage 1: short phone screen (30m) w/ recruiter + basic problem-fit check (14-day rule)
- Stage 2: technical deep-dive (virtual, 60m) w/ 2 interviewers, one domain expert + one systems/infrastructure reviewer
- Stage 3: onsite panel (4 interviews, 45m each) or consolidated 3.5h loop for final candidates
- Stage 4: hiring committee quick sync (15m) to align compensation band and get offer greenlight

Scorecard tweaks (to speed decisions):
- Reduce categories to: technical, system design, collaboration/chemistry, role-specific strength (quantifiable), and overall fit.
- Each category: 1-4 scale, must fill 1-line evidence.
- Auto-fail checkbox only for "security/+compliance red flag" or "can't perform core responsibility".

Debrief cadence: aim for 24–48h after final loop. If someone misses debrief slot, automatically escalate to hiring manager for resolution.

Candidate prioritization notes (current mental model):
- Green: strong match + available now. (fast-track)
- Amber: solid but needs one skill uptrain (ok for Jan start)
- Red: mismatch or long notice period (hold)

Draft risk register (quick):
- Risk: Interviewer burnout in mid-Dec -> Impact: delayed loops -> Mitigation: create holiday rota and enforce max 3 interviews/week per interviewer (owner: Raj).
- Risk: Budget gate delayed until Jan -> Impact: offers delayed -> Mitigation: pre-approve 3 contingency offers from hiring pot (owner: People Ops lead).
- Risk: Ramp support shortage (no mentor) -> Impact: slow productivity -> Mitigation: pair new hire with cross-team mentor for 8 weeks (owner: Diego).

Concrete action items (scrappy — update after every sync):
- [ ] Create calendar rota template for interviewers (Raj) — due 2025-11-10
- [ ] Finalize condensed scorecard template and push to GH (Olivia) — due 2025-11-07
- [ ] Ask Eng finance to confirm hiring pot release threshold (Maya) — due 2025-11-09
- [ ] Pre-draft offer language for senior IC roles (comp bands) (Olivia + Raj) — due 2025-11-12
- [ ] Build candidate short-list one-pager for each P0 role (hiring managers) — due 2025-11-13
- [ ] Schedule weekly HC sync recurring invite (Olivia) — actioned 2025-11-04

Interview question bank (scratch):
- Systems SRE: "Walk me through your most recent incident — what immediate triage did you do, and what changed after postmortem?"
- Serving infra SWE: "Given a 3x traffic spike on token generation, how would you prioritize mitigations across batching, caching, and autoscaling?"
- Applied ML infra: "How do you measure and validate that quantization did not materially degrade user-visible quality?"
- Cross-functional: "Tell me about a time you pushed back on product scope for technical constraints — how did you handle stakeholders?"

Notes-to-self (messy):
- Consider lightweight phone-based code challenge for SWE candidates to reduce wasted onsite time (maybe 20m take-home?). Pros: faster filter. Cons: might bias against time-poor candidates.
- Explore vendor/hiring agency for narrow senior roles if we miss internal pipeline — cost vs speed tradeoffs. Document potential agencies and retainer terms.
- Check legal re: relocation package template — Diego to loop in legal.

Meeting follow-up template (for debriefs):
- Candidate name / role / stage completed
- Panel composition
- Summary notes (3 lines)
- Scorecard snapshot (scores + evidence line)
- Recommendation (hire / no-hire / hold)
- Offer ask (comp band and any sign-on / relocation)
- Owner for next step and due date

Open questions (to resolve in next 1:1):
- Can we compress interview loops in Dec without sacrificing quality? (need buy-in from infra leads)
- What are firm cross-team coverage guarantees for first 8 weeks after hire? (seek commitments)
- If budget approval slides, what's the fastest path to convert a green candidate to offer? (confirm approvals matrix)

Meeting notes archive pointers (for later):
- Keep a running thread of candidate micro-decisions in /People/hiring-log (Confluence).
- Tag candidate GH cards with "hc-priority" so recruiter can surface them in weekly sync.

Final quick thoughts:
- This sprint will be messy; prioritize flow and candidate experience over perfect scorecards. Fast decisions win good candidates.
- Keep managers honest on "must-have" vs "nice-to-have" to avoid scope creep in job specs.

End of scratchbook — will refine into a cleaned one-pager and share before next HC sync.
